## My favorite plot

```{r}
x<- seq(from = -3, to = 3, length.out=100)
y <- dnorm(x, mean = 0, sd = 1)

norm_approx<- data.frame(x,y)

library(ggplot2)

scatterplot <- ggplot(data= norm_approx, aes(x=x, y=y)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("x") + ylab ("y") 

scatterplot
```

Beautiful normal distribution!
